description: Department of Local Government (Southern Province) - Mr. K. G. G. S. Ananda was electerd as the Mayor of Hambantota Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the election result of a specific individual (Mr. Kaburugamuwa Gamarachchige Gamini Sri Ananda) to the position of Mayor of Hambantota Municipal Council. The notice is issued under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and its amendments, making it clearly related to electoral processes and results, which falls under the Elections classification (Type 7).
